title: Kiln's kept versions (<data>/library/kiln-kept.json), format 1
description: Written by the launcher and kilnctl (kiln_manage::kept, since 0.2.0-dev.29). Which earlier Library entries an update kept for a roll back, per mod, with the settings their game-folder copies held at that moment (copied under <data>/library/kiln-kept/<kind>/<id>/<dir>/, each file at its path relative to the game folder; a new copy always gets a new folder), the settings a roll back put back into a profile until that version's next placement there, and the record of a change whose profile save is not confirmed yet (pending). Written in one durable write; at its next read under its lock Kiln finishes or undoes a pending change by what its profile lists, drops entries whose Library entry or settings copy is gone, and deletes every folder below kiln-kept/ it does not name. A kept entry is an ordinary Library entry (<data>/library/<kind>/<id>/<version>+<hash8>/ with its record). A launcher before dev.29 does not read this file. A file of another format is left as it is.

mods.description: One per mod that has a kept version or a restore waiting.

pending.description: A change written before its profile was saved: undone when the profile still lists every version it replaced, else finished.

kind.description: The Library kind (kiln, native, plugin, emf, eml, shroudforge, set, greeneye, flame, ...).

kept.description: Newest kept first; at most keepVersions (settings.json, default 1, at most 5).

restores.description: At most one per profile: a roll back put this version into that profile, and its settings go back into its copy in the game they came from (settings.game) at its next placement there.

hash.description: kdh1 (sha256 for a plugin DLL), as in the Library.

replacedBy.description: The version that took its place then.

profile.description: The profile whose change left it (when that profile lists it again without Kiln following the change, it is no longer kept).
The profile that rolled back: only its placement takes or applies them.

applied.description: Its files are back and flushed; only the record is left to drop (the next look drops it without putting the files back again).

settings.description: What was copied from the mod's game-folder copies: every file not as Kiln placed it (changed or added since) that is no code and no manifest, at most 16 MiB a file and 64 MiB in all.

files.description: Paths relative to the game folder, '/' separated.

values.description: ShroudForge setting values (extended.mod.json settings.<key>.value) by copy (its path relative to the game folder): put back with ShroudForge's own setter.

game.description: The game folder they were read in: a restore applies there only.

leftOut.description: What was not copied (too large, unreadable), one sentence each.

dir.description: The copy's folder under kiln-kept/<kind>/<id>/: <version>+<hash8>.<12 hex>; absent when no file was copied.

changes.description: Each profile entry the change replaces: the version before and after.

before.description: The state each touched mod had before (an empty one: none): what an undo puts back.

profileBefore.description: Profile mods before the save; recovery compares the touched entries, including removals.
